summary: The legal array length is restricted to 2 through 6, whose total 3x span cannot support the required 4x runtime-scaling comparison; the complete distinct state space is at most 6! = 720 tuples.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 2 <= n == nums1.length == nums2.length <= 6, and nums2 is a permutation of nums1

replacement_checks.evidence: Breadth-first search visits at most n! <= 720 distinct tuples; each tuple enumerates O(n^3) block-and-gap choices and constructs O(n)-length successors, establishing O(n! n^4) time and O(n! n) space.

The certificate regression compares the accepted solver with an independently constructed shortest-path oracle for every one of the 872 distinct target permutations at lengths 2 through 6 and for every equal-multiset pair of binary arrays through length 6, covering duplicate-state collapse.
